comments.text:
Wes, I'd really love if you could re-visit this topic with a bit more detail. 
ComfyUi isn't just for Stable Diffusion - ComfyUi is a very busy, highly supported ecosystem  that can use LLMs, Video models and many many other systems and tools too. 

It's Photoshop of the generative era, and is most likely the place where artists will be innovating in the coming years.
Workflows can do ANYTHING:
Like turning bird song into a t-shirt design,
or re-designing your living room with new furniture,
or making video chains that link beginning and end frames to make movies. 
New models are being supported in ComfyUi the day after their release on Huggingface.

You're not a Harry... you're a Dumbledor!
